zh.title: 拉脫維亞考慮採購A-29超級大嘴鳥飛機以應對無人機
zh.summary: 拉脫維亞考慮採購巴西航空工業A-29飛機以應對無人機威脅
body: 面對日益增加的無人機威脅，拉脫維亞正考慮採購巴西航空工業（Embraer）的A-29超級大嘴鳥（Super Tucano）渦輪螺旋槳輕型攻擊機，以作為無人機獵手。拉脫維亞國家武裝部隊空軍指揮官維斯圖爾斯·馬蘇利斯（Viesturs Masulis）上校表示，採購此類飛機是一個務實的選項，儘管任何航空解決方案都需要龐大的資金。
馬蘇利斯上校表示，他將鼓勵其繼任者埃德蒙茲·斯文奇斯（Edmunds Svenčs）上校關注這款渦輪螺旋槳飛機，將其視為應對慢速飛行目標與無人機的空基防空能力。目前，拉脫維亞已撥款超過10億歐元（約12億美元）用於加強其防空建設。

en.title: Latvia Considers Purchasing Embraer A-29 Super Tucanos to Counter Drone Threats
en.summary: Latvia evaluates Embraer A-29 Super Tucano aircraft to counter rising drone threats.
body: Faced with increasing drone threats, Latvia is considering purchasing Embraer A-29 Super Tucano turboprop light combat aircraft to act as drone hunters. National Armed Forces Air Force Commander Colonel Viesturs Masulis stated that acquiring such aircraft is a realistic option, although any aviation solution requires significant financial resources.

Masulis stated that he would encourage his successor, Colonel Edmunds Svenčs, to focus on these turboprop aircraft as an air-based air-defence capability, particularly for combating slow-flying targets and drones. Currently, Latvia has allocated over €1 billion ($1.2 billion) to strengthen its overall air defence.
